target.title: fix(skills): skill workshop apply hangs despite auto approval
target.body:
Closes #102508

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who set Skill Workshop approval to auto could still see agent-initiated `skill_workshop apply`, `reject`, or `quarantine` calls wait for approval and time out when the before-tool-call context did not include a config object.

AI-assisted.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Skill Workshop lifecycle approval resolver now keeps explicit hook config authoritative, but falls back to the current runtime config when hook config is absent. If runtime config cannot be read, it keeps the existing default pending approval behavior so this does not weaken the approval boundary.

## User Impact

Users in trusted environments can apply, reject, or quarantine Skill Workshop proposals through agent chat without an unnecessary approval timeout when `skills.workshop.approvalPolicy` is set to `"auto"`. Pending approval remains the default unless that existing config is explicitly set.

## Evidence

Source-level before proof: on current `upstream/main`, `resolveSkillWorkshopToolApproval` resolves `resolveSkillWorkshopConfig(params.config)` directly, so an absent hook config resolves to the default `approvalPolicy: "pending"` instead of the runtime `"auto"` setting.

After-fix production-path probe:

```shell
node --import tsx --input-type=module -e '...runBeforeToolCallHook({ toolName: "skill_workshop", params: { action: "apply", proposal_id: "weather-20260530-a1b2c3d4e5" }, ctx: { agentId: "main", sessionKey: "main" } })...'
{"blocked":false,"params":{"action":"apply","proposal_id":"weather-20260530-a1b2c3d4e5"}}
```

Focused validation:

```shell
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write --threads=1 src/skills/workshop/policy.ts src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.embedded-mode.test.ts

# passed
```
